t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Qui lakatin, oh qui Dios, wish qui malakastaknita la qui nak lakapazan chu nak lakachiscuhuiyan. Qui lakatin chiyó qui nitu lìpawan chu mi li liguaka, qui litamaxxat chu mi li langa. Nitu tanu Dios mas qui Uió, Nkè a mbedzam, enyo ato'o ai émen.
